title: English Practice Quiz 0803
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Emergency Preparedness 01: During an evacuation, staff should:
options: Follow the designated route and instructions
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: Follow the designated route and instructions. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.

questions.question: Emergency Preparedness 02: An assembly point is where people:
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: Gather after evacuating. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.

questions.question: Emergency Preparedness 03: An emergency contact list should be:
options: Current and accessible to authorised staff
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: Current and accessible to authorised staff. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.

questions.question: Emergency Preparedness 04: If you discover smoke, you should:
options: Raise the alarm and follow emergency procedures
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: Raise the alarm and follow emergency procedures. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.

questions.question: Emergency Preparedness 05: A fire extinguisher should be used by:
options: A trained person when safe and appropriate
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: A trained person when safe and appropriate. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.

questions.question: Emergency Preparedness 06: Emergency drills are conducted to:
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: Practise responses and identify gaps. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.

questions.question: Emergency Preparedness 07: A first aider should work:
options: Within their training and the site's emergency protocol
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: Within their training and the site's emergency protocol. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.

questions.question: Emergency Preparedness 08: During a power failure, staff should:
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: Follow the site's contingency procedure. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.

questions.question: Emergency Preparedness 09: An emergency route must remain:
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: Clear and accessible. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.

questions.question: Emergency Preparedness 10: After an emergency drill, the team should:
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: Review performance and corrective actions. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.
